name: Cong Wang
summary: A pressure boxer-kickboxer from a Sanda base, the most accurate striker in the division's history per UFC.com: busy, clean and composed, winning with volume rather than one-shot power.

how_they_fight.Striking: Sanda and pro kickboxing background. Sound boxing fundamentals at middle range; throws about 6.4 significant strikes a minute. Pressure is the engine: she walks opponents down, cuts the cage and lands in combination rather than loading up.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Willing to clinch and has shown top position, but the one loss on her record (2024) was a submission to Gabriella Fernandes: the ground is the least-proven part of her game.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stops about 85% of takedowns. Hard to hurt standing; her last four fights all went the distance.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Holds a high pace for three rounds; five rounds and a championship weight cut are unknowns. Per the coach's breakdown, she missed weight earlier this year: the cut is a real question for a five-round fight.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Composed; fights to a plan. Says she'll 'fight smart' and take a finish only if it's offered (BJPenn.com).

patterns: Walks forward behind a jab and cuts the cage
Scores in combinations of three or four
Accurate counter when opponents lead into her
concerns: Weight cut for a five-round title fight
Chasing an elusive opponent can leave her missing and reaching
keys_to_beat: Keep changing range so she has to chase
Kick at range and exit at angles; don't box with her
Threaten takedowns to make her stand taller

news.text: Says Silva is 'the toughest I've ever faced' and that she'll finish her if given an opening; underdog for the vacant title.
